title: Enforce evidence feedback, admission and completion
owner: dot — operational evidence framework; implementation author not dispatched
phase: queued registration proposal; independent exact-head registration acceptance required before admission

ask.author: Craig
ask.request: Enforce, deterministic framework, persisted on GH
ask.scope: Register the deterministic evidence-feedback framework in GitHub. This change registers only; no implementation or merge.

bug_shape: Structured inspection failures can remain reports without coordinator reconciliation into an existing rule, a task-specific limitation, or a justified reusable guideline with a regression; later briefs and completion claims can therefore repeat the evidence failure.

ownership.inspector: Read-only: emit structured findings and citations. No inspector rule/task mutation, worker dispatch, merge, or automatic repair.
ownership.coordinator: Owns explicit reconciliation decisions and admission against current authoritative rules. Preserve existing owner, stops and denials; findings cannot authorize new tasks or contact.
ownership.worker: One admitted author for this operational task; cannot self-accept.
ownership.reviewer: Separate independent reviewer judges exact implementation head and each criterion; human visual judgments remain explicit.

integration_hold: watch.py, coordinator.py, coordinator_cli.py, test_rules.py, RUNBOOK.md, README.md and COORDINATOR.md remain with PR396's current owner until exact-region handoff
Canonical SYSTEM.md, WORKER_BRIEF.md, VALIDATOR_BRIEF.md and COORDINATOR.md visual-onboarding hunks remain reserved by PR143; reconcile its current accepted content before any overlapping edit
implementation_scope.sequence: After registration acceptance and fresh ownership/tool preflight, one author may implement disjoint pure module, isolated fixtures/tests and its own documentation. Do not block disjoint work on PR396. Integration into coordinator/watch entrypoints is serialized after the overlapping owner correction and exact-region handoff; no parallel replacement or bypass evaluator.
excluded: blanket new guideline for each repeated failure

finding: stable finding ID and failure fingerprint
source repository, full observed head SHA and observation timestamp
evidence locations and machine-readable failure code
reconciliation: Coordinator records finding-to-decision links with rationale and provenance

Choose existing_rule with exact rule ID/revision; task_limitation with bounded scope and required evidence/action; or reusable_guideline with incident, generalization rationale, authoritative rule delta and executable regression
Duplicate findings reconcile idempotently; frequency alone does not justify a new guideline
Unresolved or contradictory findings cannot silently become satisfied; no auto-created game repair tasks
admission: Current authoritative rule manifest pinned by repository full commit and rule blob revisions
Worker brief acknowledges current applicable rule revisions
Every criterion has a concrete evidence plan: method, artifact path/type, source/build/variant binding where relevant, coverage and designated independent reviewer
Unknown current rules, stale acknowledgment or incomplete criterion plan denies admission with a scoped reason; authorized disjoint work is not suppressed by unrelated publication holds
completion: Fail closed for missing, stale, uncommitted, inaccessible, unbound or unmapped required evidence
Verify committed paths/blobs at exact immutable artifact/source refs; text claims or a file's mere existence are not proof
Evidence maps every criterion and all claimed defect instances; build-dependent evidence identifies exact source/build/variant

Independent verdict must name the full candidate head SHA, reviewer identity distinct from author, per-criterion decision and inspected citations; absent, stale, self-authored or partial verdict fails acceptance
Changed source/rules/evidence invalidates prior decision; preserve author/test/independent-review/human-visual gates as distinct states

Explicit human visual/device judgments cannot be inferred from numeric image differences, a script result, generic screenshots or green tests; pending human verdict remains pending and cannot become automatic completion

Distinguish reviewed implementation/source head from later evidence-only commit and artifact tree. Later evidence/verdict commits may bind the prior implementation head only after verifying the relevant source scope is unchanged; changed source invalidates affected evidence. Avoid a circular demand that a verdict cite the commit containing itself.

Retained historical evidence requires verified unchanged relevant source scope and applicable build/environment provenance; never accept old artifacts solely because filenames or metadata look correct.
applicability: Define explicit criterion applicability with rationale and authority; missing parsed criteria or empty citation lists never vacuously PASS
Nonvisual criteria use appropriate logs/assertions/diffs rather than compulsory screenshots; visual criteria retain required matched per-instance before/after review and explicit human gates

completion_criteria.criterion: Structured findings have deterministic, provenance-preserving coordinator reconciliation without inspector mutation or blanket guideline creation.
completion_criteria.verification: Fixtures cover existing-rule, task-limitation, reusable-guideline-plus-regression, duplicate replay, unresolved and conflicting finding cases; identical inputs yield identical decisions. Newly generalized rules must have a regression that fails on the recorded broken fixture.

completion_criteria.criterion: Admission enforces current rule revision acknowledgment and a complete per-criterion evidence plan.
completion_criteria.verification: Positive control plus missing/stale rule pin, changed rule blob, missing criterion/method/artifact/source coverage and malformed plan cases; verify scoped rejection and preservation of unrelated permitted operations. Include zero parsed criteria, empty applicability/citations and unsupported not-applicable exclusions; each applicable criterion remains accounted for.

completion_criteria.criterion: Completion fails closed on missing/stale/uncommitted/inaccessible/unmapped evidence and absent independent exact-head verdict.
completion_criteria.verification: Table-driven negatives for each class, changed full SHA, wrong build/variant, partial coverage, self-review, no citation, partial verdict and stale evidence; complete exact-head control passes only machine-checkable gates. Include evidence-only commits with proven unchanged source as a positive control, altered relevant source as a negative, and historical evidence with/without verified scope equivalence. Do not use filenames or metadata as automatic semantic PASS.

completion_criteria.criterion: Human visual judgment and stopped ownership remain explicit gates.
completion_criteria.verification: Tests show missing/rejected/pending human verdict never becomes accepted from script/numeric/CI results; stopped tasks remain stopped, no redispatch or owner transfer follows from findings.

completion_criteria.criterion: General framework, schema/examples and regression tests are committed in GitHub; evaluator is side-effect-free.
completion_criteria.verification: Run isolated tests locally with filesystem writes, external API, subprocess dispatch and queue/ledger mutation mocked to raise; commit exact commands/results and public-safe fixtures. No Actions execution.

completion_criteria.criterion: After serialized owner handoff, applicable admission/completion routes consume the shared result without bypass.
completion_criteria.verification: Inspect exact post-PR396 integration diff and run route/alias negatives plus existing regression suite locally; do not claim enforcement of live external schedulers. Preserve PR143 visual-onboarding content and cite accepted rule revision. Specifically test evidence-check failure exit codes, brief-check semantic plan validation and validator-check rejecting zero citations/zero parsed criteria. Capture a read-only current real-input acceptance-check invocation with pinned source manifest and resulting decisions/limitations; standalone synthetic tests do not establish adoption. No external scheduler or inspector mutation.

completion_criteria.criterion: Separate independent acceptance review cites exact final head and every criterion.
completion_criteria.verification: Reviewer opens original artifacts, reruns relevant local checks and records per-criterion PASS/FAIL with immutable citations. Implementation remains in_review until required acceptance; all human gates and verification limitations stay visible.
